headline: Brandon removes tuition fees for Indigenous language courses
meta_description: Brandon has eliminated tuition fees for Indigenous language courses, making cultural education accessible to more learners.
summary_short: Brandon removes tuition barriers for Indigenous language courses, opening cultural education to community members who couldn't previously afford it.
body:
Brandon has eliminated tuition fees for Indigenous language courses, removing a significant financial barrier to cultural education.

The decision opens access to these courses for community members who may have faced affordability challenges. By removing cost as an obstacle, Brandon creates space for more people to learn and connect with Indigenous languages and cultural heritage.

This move reflects a growing recognition that Indigenous language education strengthens communities and preserves knowledge systems. Making these courses tuition-free signals a commitment to ensuring that financial circumstances don't determine who gets to participate in cultural learning.
quick_facts: Brandon eliminated tuition fees for Indigenous language courses
Removes financial barriers to cultural education
Makes courses accessible to more community members
